ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:18 ratio of high-intensity (white/scars) to low-intensity (black/pigment) pixels across the visible ventral surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The surface is characterized by a uniform low-intensity dark field. High-contrast contiguous white annular rings (rosettes) are distributed non-uniformly, with a cluster of 5 in the distal right lobe and 4 in the distal left lobe, plus sparse medial distribution.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature sweep on the cranial aspect of both lobes, tapering to acute, irregular distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three unaligned, low-contrast horizontal linear pixel streaks located in the mid-medial region of the left fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive annular rosette scarring and irregular jagged tissue loss along the trailing edge topography.
